name: score-association
finding: A passive host span processor maps each run and segment to its own trace; the host posts trace scores without a galaxie API change.

name: score-idempotency
finding: Resending the stored payload preserves one score, including a timestamp from two days earlier. A later-day payload with the same ID replaced the visible row's value and returned one row; a control with a distinct ID showed duplicates would be visible. Whether a second physical row exists behind the read API is not measured.

name: score-before-ingestion
finding: Langfuse accepted a trace score before observations existed; after explicit flush the same single score and all three observations were found.

name: langfuse-sessions
finding: Root-only session IDs group the three roots per session, but omit six child observations. The host copier groups all nine observations per session without a collector change.

name: mlflow-sessions
finding: The existing collector's root session copy is sufficient for MLflow's trace metadata session filter. Both sessions return exactly their three traces, with no mixing.

name: mlflow-root-io
finding: Evaluation returns six rows and one non-null value per scorer per trace in each text mode. Root request and response remain empty even with chat text opt-in, because invoke_agent carries no input or output. Trace scorers still measure usage and chat text.
proposedFix: Decide a framework-neutral root-span input/output contract under the existing development text opt-in, live data-label checks and final-destination policy. Keep text absent by default and keep backend-specific mapping in the host collector.

name: browser-endpoint
finding: A same-origin host endpoint holds the Langfuse key, confirms run/segment/trace metadata, and binds the association to its cookie user. Wrong associations return 404, another owner returns 403 and no cookie returns 401. First-report binding and client-controlled telemetry remain fixture limits.
